column1: # Which branch is which, declared once (#326).
# The INTEGRATION branch is the repository's default branch: every pull
# request targets it, a newer push to it supersedes the run in flight, and
# Pages publishes from it. Everything that RUNS reads it as the default
# `origin/HEAD` or `gh repo view --json defaultBranchRef` in a script -- and
# from here only as check-history.py's last resort, when neither origin/HEAD
# nor the event names it (#386, ruled at 5982083482).
# The RELEASE branch takes only release pull requests from the integration
# branch; a run on the way into it is never cancelled. A `branches:` list and
# a concurrency expression cannot read a file, so both names are spelled
